title: AtlasArtifactSet
description: A single quantized model variant as a set of files: shards grouped together, distinct quant variants kept separate, companion files recorded apart from main weights. Specification version 0.2.0 (Phase 2).

schema_version.description: Specification version of this record (0.2.0 at Phase 2 introduction).

revision.description: Resolved immutable revision; null when unknown, never invented.

variant.description: Exact quant label, e.g. Q4_K_M. Distinct variants are never merged as shards.

format.description: Container/serialization format, never the quantization scheme itself.

kind.description: Whether this variant is one file or grouped shards of one variant.

shards_complete.description: True only when every expected shard index is present exactly once.

total_source_reported_bytes.description: Sum of source-reported file sizes; null when any size is missing.

primary_weight_bytes.description: Weight bytes only; companion artifacts are recorded separately.

companion_components.description: Companion kinds present (tokenizer, config, index, projector, docs).
